experiment: Readout activation contribution pulse, every denoise call. Same prefix, noise, and stock model.
schema: position [row,column], Y/Z are rows 1/2. Positive/negative readout pulse scale = ±0.2. Full actions are 10 native commands with XYZ, RPY, gripper. RMS is native all-seven-axis RMS.
method: Only selectable columns are beyond prior 16 values. Frozen hidden readout prefilter on fit data, then full sampler signed intervention. Single-context verification of strongest nonduplicate pulses.
